question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-scoped web/tool credential override surface, and should that surface live under agents.list[].tools.web, plugin-owned per-agent config, or another unified credential model?
rationale: This choice changes credential isolation, SecretRef precedence, plugin ownership boundaries, and config compatibility; source inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the product/security contract.

options.title: Design unified credential contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into plugin config design
options.body: Treat this as a subset of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55401 and require the generic per-agent plugin-config contract to explicitly cover web-search credentials.

options.title: Decline per-agent tool credentials
options.body: Close after documenting that separate gateways or external credential isolation remain the supported boundary for distinct web-search billing/accounts.

recommendation.title: Design unified credential contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans config compatibility, secrets runtime, and plugin-boundary ownership where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
